intro: Across 29 articles published between 12 April and 15 September 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of critical infrastructure tracked activity attributed to APT33, CL-STA-1062, and CyberAv3ngers. Reporting centred on CVE-2026-24032, which carries a CVSS score of 7.3. The sectors most frequently examined were energy, critical infrastructure, government, critical-infrastructure, and utilities. Geographically, coverage spanned the United states, Global, North america, Europe, and Asia-pacific. The severity mix across the tag comprised 15 high, 3 critical, 3 informational, and 1 medium.
